description: This file implements the UnitConverter class, which manages unit conversions, categories, and related data. It includes methods for setting categories and units, performing conversions, serializing/deserializing preferences, and handling currency-specific data. The code interacts with data loaders and callbacks to update the view model and supports complex conversion logic including suggested values and formatting.

classes.name: UnitConverter
classes.description: A class responsible for managing unit conversions, categories, and currency data, including serialization, deserialization, and interaction with data loaders and callbacks.

methods.name: UnitConverter
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the UnitConverter with data loaders, optionally for currency data.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Loads data into the converter.

methods.name: CheckLoad
methods.description: Checks if categories are loaded, and resets if necessary.

methods.name: GetCategories
methods.description: Returns the list of categories.

methods.name: SetCurrentCategory
methods.description: Sets the current category and updates units accordingly.

methods.name: GetCurrentCategory
methods.description: Returns the current category.

methods.name: SetCurrentUnitTypes
methods.description: Sets the source and target units for conversion and triggers calculation.

methods.name: SwitchActive
methods.description: Swaps source and target units and updates display values.

methods.name: IsSwitchedActive
methods.description: Returns whether the active units have been switched.

methods.name: CategoryToString
methods.description: Serializes a category to string.

methods.name: StringToVector
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens based on a delimiter.

methods.name: UnitToString
methods.description: Serializes a unit to string.

methods.name: StringToUnit
methods.description: Deserializes a string into a Unit object.

methods.name: StringToCategory
methods.description: Deserializes a string into a Category object.

methods.name: RestoreUserPreferences
methods.description: Restores converter state from a serialized string.

methods.name: SaveUserPreferences
methods.description: Serializes the current converter state.

methods.name: Quote
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string for serialization.

methods.name: Unquote
methods.description: Reverts escaped characters back to original.

methods.name: SendCommand
methods.description: Handles user commands for input and control.

methods.name: SetViewModelCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback for updating the view model.

methods.name: SetViewModelCurrencyCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback for currency-related updates.

methods.name: RefreshCurrencyRatios
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes currency ratios from web.

methods.name: GetCurrencyConverterDataLoader
methods.description: Returns the currency data loader if available.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Performs conversion calculation based on ratio and offset.

methods.name: CalculateSuggested
methods.description: Calculates suggested alternative values for display.

methods.name: ResetCategoriesAndRatios
methods.description: Resets categories and conversion ratios.

methods.name: GetDataLoaderForCategory
methods.description: Returns the appropriate data loader for a category.

methods.name: InitializeSelectedUnits
methods.description: Initializes source and target units based on current category.

methods.name: ClearValues
methods.description: Resets display and decimal flags.

methods.name: AnyUnitIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if source or target unit is uninitialized.

methods.name: Calculate
methods.description: Performs the main conversion calculation and updates display.

methods.name: UpdateCurrencySymbols
methods.description: Updates currency symbols and ratios in the view model.

methods.name: UpdateViewModel
methods.description: Updates the display and suggested values in the view model.
